content.comment_body: Hello, I need to configure the parameters "Pulse width (TH)" and "Interpulse width (TL)" of the Asynchronous Pulse Generator using the operator panel over an Ethernet connection. Is this possible with [product_name] [article_no] and an HMI panel? Does anyone have experience with similar applications? Thank you! Best regards, [user_name]
See the attachment: It's only a partial program, with only TH configured via network inputs. You can duplicate this approach for your own program.

analysis.insight_summary: The user asked about remotely configuring Asynchronous Pulse Generator parameters ('Pulse width (TH)' and 'Interpulse width (TL)') on a [product_name] module using an HMI over Ethernet. Another user provided a partial example addressing only one parameter and suggested replicating the solution. The thread indicates that network-based parameter configuration is possible to an extent, but lacks a detailed solution for both parameters, leaving the overall guidance incomplete.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to be able to completely set both 'Pulse width (TH)' and 'Interpulse width (TL)' parameters remotely via Ethernet using an HMI panel with the [product_name] [article_no] module.
